rules.title: RSO allowable annual rent increase
rules.requirement: For RSO-covered units, rent may be increased only once every 12 months by the allowable rent increase percentage published by LAHD; no additional utility percentage may be added since February 2, 2026.
rules.coverage_text: Rental properties first built on or before October 1, 1978 (and replacement units), including apartments, duplexes, etc.; condominiums and townhomes are not rent regulated for tenancies commenced after December 31, 1995.

exemption_tests.description: Condominiums and townhomes with tenancies commenced after December 31, 1995 are not rent regulated.
Luxury exemption: landlord may apply for exemption if monthly rent charged on or before May 31, 1978 can be established.
Rooms in hotels, motels, rooming/boarding houses are covered only when occupied by same tenant for more than 30 consecutive days.

rules.exemptions_text: Condos/townhomes with tenancies after 12/31/1995 not rent regulated; luxury exemption.
rules.citation: Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (LAMC § 151.00 et seq.); LAHD RSO Overview
rules.quoted_span: Rent may be increased once every 12 months by the allowable rent increase percentage (click here to view the allowable rent increase PDF ).
rules.key_value: Once every 12 months by allowable percentage
rules.ambiguity_note: Page states utilities increase eliminated effective February 2, 2026; percentage not stated in text.

rules.title: Additional tenant 10% increase; dependent increase eliminated
rules.requirement: Effective February 2, 2026, landlords may no longer add 10% for an additional dependent; a 10% increase is allowed for an additional non-dependent tenant, within 60 days of learning of the tenant.
rules.quoted_span: However, a 10% for an additional tenant is allowed (not a dependent) if moves into a rental unit: Landlords can increase the rent within 60 days of learning about the additional tenant.
rules.ambiguity_note: Page text on additional-tenant rules is garbled.

rules.title: RSO legal reasons for eviction (just cause)
rules.requirement: Landlords of RSO units may evict only for listed at-fault reasons (e.g., nonpayment, lease violation, nuisance) or no-fault reasons (e.g., owner move-in, demolition, government order), and no-fault evictions require relocation assistance.
rules.coverage_text: RSO-covered units; non-RSO properties are covered by the separate Just Cause Ordinance.
rules.quoted_span: No-fault evictions require the payment of relocation assistance.

rules.title: Just Cause Ordinance for non-RSO properties
rules.requirement: Even properties not covered by the RSO have tenant rights and responsibilities under the Just Cause Ordinance.
rules.coverage_text: Rental properties not covered by RSO.
rules.citation: Just Cause Ordinance (as referenced in LAHD RSO Overview)
rules.quoted_span: Even if your property is not covered under the Rent Stabilization Ordinance, you and your tenants have rights and responsibilities under the Just Cause Ordinance.
rules.ambiguity_note: Summary reference only; no details given.

rules.title: Interest payments on security deposits
rules.requirement: The RSO covers interest payments on security deposits; details not stated.
rules.ambiguity_note: Only listed as a topic; no rule details.
